historical_transitions.summary: Controller deployment and role configuration at block 16683911 (2023-02-22). Receipt status 0x1 and contractAddress 0x16F692525f3b8c8a96F8c945D365Da958Fb5735B. Logs include RoleAdminChanged for TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE, RoleGranted for TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE to the Timelock itself, for PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE to dao() 0x718b7885fec8511dc8f2a378d3045c90e82d6a1d, to 0x3e29bf7b...c683a6 and to deployer 0xef76d4e7...3fcd1, for EXECUTOR_ROLE to dao(), plus MinDelayChange. getMinDelay() returns 3600 seconds and hasRole confirms dao() holds PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER roles.

NodeDAOView ERC1967Proxy deployment at block 19517007 (2024-03-26). Receipt status 0x1 emits Upgraded to implementation 0x857BF02B1f5fD85E064e6726658eA1864a14d948, OwnershipTransferred from 0x0 to the Timelock 0x16F692525f3b8c8a96F8c945D365Da958Fb5735B, and Initialized. The implementation is verified NodeDAOView (solc v0.8.8) and exposes UUPS onlyOwner _authorizeUpgrade, so the control plane is upgradeable rather than immutable; trajectory_mode is mutable_transitions. The separate dao() authority is 0x718b7885fec8511dc8f2a378d3045c90e82d6a1d. This contract is a view/registry component, not the custody vault behind the protocol-wide TVL.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: Real dated commit 'fix' in the NodeDAO organisation's Go tooling repository. It shows off-chain maintenance but publishes no Solidity source tree for the deployed implementation and no dated commit predating the 2023 Timelock or 2024 proxy deployments. Verified Solidity does exist on Blockscout/Sourcify; what is absent is pre-deployment GitHub provenance.

Dated Internet Archive capture of the official NodeDAO site before the proxy deployment. This sampled page describes the liquid-staking product without disclosing the ERC1967 proxy, the Timelock owner, the dao() authority or the 3600-second delay.

Current official site, answering HTTP 200. This sampled live page documents the protocol but does not publish the implementation 0x857BF02B..., the owner Timelock 0x16F69252..., the dao() address or the Timelock role holders.

gap_windows.summary: Documentation-to-chain disclosure gap bounded to the three sampled pages. Those sampled pages do not publish the implementation, the owner 0x16F692525f3b8c8a96F8c945D365Da958Fb5735B, the dao() authority 0x718b7885fec8511dc8f2a378d3045c90e82d6a1d, the 3600-second delay or the Timelock role holders, while the control plane is reproducible from the two receipts, archive eth_getStorageAt samples and hasRole probes. This is NOT a claim of continuous absence across every documentation page. The window opens at the first verified control-plane transition (block 16683911) and remains open with no closed block.

executive_risk_memo:
This revision corrects the four REVISION_NEEDED findings on the NodeDAO dossier. The target 0xd7C049CD4ba216679ecC04Eb2767cC5E39812121 is a verified ERC1967Proxy whose verified implementation 0x857BF02B...a14d948 is the 'NodeDAOView' contract (Blockscout, solc v0.8.8+commit.dddeac2f). It is explicitly a view and registry component: the 25,237,436 USD figure is protocol-wide Ethereum TVL from DefiLlama, NOT value custodied by this contract. NodeDAOView also exposes a separate onlyDao authority path, dao() = 0x718b7885...6a1d, alongside owner() = the TimelockController 0x16F692...735B. Both authority paths are now acknowledged rather than collapsed into a single owner.

The misattributed transition is withdrawn. Transaction 0x2bbae609e4f7a88edeeb0b5a691d707f012a9c2e6cab82fd4be5e4a3421603e2 at block 19,518,439 did NOT grant timelock roles or set minDelay; its receipt emits CallScheduled and CallSalt on the Timelock targeting 0xc6572019548dfeba782ba5a2093c836626c7789a with selector 0x08211be5 and a 3600-second delay. The actual controller was deployed much earlier, at block 16,683,911 (2023-02-22) in transaction 0x019fc3bc49cd5017cf0358856179a9e4873da0d94f0e6b3f3cc58260a0bf4e37, which created 0x16F692...735B, emitted RoleAdminChanged for TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE, granted TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE to the Timelock itself, granted PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE to dao() 0x718b7885...6a1d, to 0x3e29bf7b650b8910f3b4ddda5b146e8716c683a6 and to the deployer 0xef76d4e75154739f75f6068b3470c7968cc3fcd1, granted EXECUTOR_ROLE to dao(), and emitted MinDelayChange. Direct hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, dao()), hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, dao()) and hasRole(CANCELLER_ROLE, dao()) calls all return true, while getMinDelay() returns 3600 seconds. Standard getRoleMemberCount/getRoleMember revert on this controller, so the role holders above are enumerated from the deployment RoleGranted logs and hasRole probes rather than from the OZ enumerable getters.

The contract is UUPS-upgradeable, not immutable. The verified Version.sol on 0x857BF02B... implements onlyOwner _authorizeUpgrade with typeId and version+1 checks, so trajectory_mode is now mutable_transitions. No Upgraded event was observed after the deployment block in the sampled archive windows (blocks 20,000,000, 21,000,000, 22,000,000, 23,000,000, 24,000,000, 25,000,000, 26,000,000 and 26,450,616), and archive eth_getStorageAt on the EIP-1967 implementation slot returns 0x857BF02B...a14d948 at every one of those sampled blocks. This is a sampled-block observation, not a full-range no-upgrade proof; the dossier does not claim that no upgrade could ever have occurred between samples.

Source provenance is now precise. Blockscout/Sourcify DO hold verified Solidity for the proxy (ERC1967Proxy) and for the implementation (NodeDAOView), both solc v0.8.8. What is missing is a dated pre-deployment commit in NodeDAO/NodeDAO-Protocol: that Solidity repository has 0 commits, 0 distinct human contributors and a bus factor of 0 in the trailing twelve months. code_before_upgrade_verified therefore remains false, but the reason is the absence of a matching GitHub commit predating on-chain deployment, not the absence of verified source. The sibling Go tooling repository NodeDAO/nodedao-tool stayed active with dated commits in April and November 2025.

The documentation-to-chain gap is bounded to the three sampled pages (the 2023 Wayback capture, the dated 2025 tooling commit and the live official site). Those sampled pages do not publish the implementation address, the owner, the dao() authority, the 3600-second delay or the role holders. The claim is limited to those sampled pages, NOT continuous absence across every documentation page, and the window opens at the first verified control-plane transition (block 16,683,911) for 1367 days.

Residual exposure is concentrated in a 3600-second delay that is far shorter than the 24-hour or 48-hour norms used by lending control planes, combined with a separate onlyDao path and UUPS upgradeability. Integrators should re-pin the implementation slot and treat any sampled-block immutability as an observation about the past only.
